summary_1line: Drona devastates the Pandava forces, killing Dhrishtaketu, his son, Jarasandha’s son, and other warriors while routing the Panchalas despite their desperate attacks.

image_candidates.scene_text: Drona releases a deadly arrow that pierces Dhrishtaketu’s armored chest and buries itself in the earth as the prince collapses from his chariot.
The aged Drona with white locks flowing fights fiercely from his chariot, surrounded by clouds of arrows and fallen warriors across the battlefield.
Drupada, enraged amid a field of bloodied bodies and circling jackals, urges his forces forward toward Drona at the head of the Parthas.
